# Kilnwick Pottery - studio records

Firing records live under kiln/ as firings-YYYY-MM.csv. The old kiln-log.csv name was
retired in the August tidy-up; the glaze room keeps its own log under glazes/.

turns.prompt: Kilnwick Pottery is summing up the month. The studio head keeps calling the sheet kiln-log.csv, but that name was retired in the August tidy-up - find the September firing sheet and tell me how many firings we ran. Just the number.
Change of plan for the report: count only the firings that reached cone 6. How many were there? The bare number, please.
Which glaze code appears most among those cone-6 firings?
How many cone-6 firings used that glaze? Number only.
And what was the average firing time across those cone-6 firings of that glaze, in hours? One decimal place is fine.
